author: Nerdstalgic
description:
For years, Dune was Hollywood’s greatest unsolvable problem.

Multiple adaptations. Mixed results. And one consistent conclusion: Dune just doesn’t work on screen.

So how did Denis Villeneuve succeed where everyone else failed?

With Dune and its sequel, he didn’t just adapt the story...he rethought how it should be told. Because sometimes the difference between failure and a masterpiece comes down to understanding what NOT to adapt.

#dune #duneparttwo #timotheechalamet #zendaya #nerdstalgic
title: Why Dune Works When It Absolutely Shouldn’t
